svg.title: Evidence maturity ladder for hemodialysis volume and blood pressure decisions
svg.desc: Seven rungs from strongest to weakest for clinical action: randomized trials on patient outcomes, systematic reviews, graded guidelines, consensus reports, observational cohorts, mechanistic reviews, and simulation or abstract-only reports. Each rung lists examples used in this guide and the verb that fits it.
svg.text: How sure are we? Match the verb to the rung
A newer date is not a higher rung. A 2026 simulation sits below a 2009 randomized trial.

g.text: MyTEMP, ACHIEVE, ALCHEMIST, CONVINCE, LUST, BISTRO, TiME, FHN, CLIMB, TAKE-HOLD, DRIP (BP endpoint)
Cochrane low dialysate sodium 2024; tool-guided target weight 2019 and 2025; bioimpedance 2023; incremental HD 2024
3 Graded guidelines (keep the issuer's own grade)
UKKA 2025 (search to Dec 2022, grades 1A–2D); KDOQI 2015 adequacy; KDIGO 2021 BP = non-dialysis scope
KDIGO 2020 Controversies Conference on BP and volume in dialysis (ungraded)
HEMO UFR analysis; weight-specific UFR cohort (396,358); IDWG and CV death (34,107); blood-volume–guided cohort 2026
HD-induced multiorgan ischemia and circulatory stress (2024)
Adaptive UF in silico study (2026); conference abstracts; registered trials without published results

svg.text: Rung order is a default: a large, well-run trial can outrank a meta-analysis of small, biased ones. CV, cardiovascular.
